text:
mike-release: FYI premerge check — prompt-eval dashboard shows a clear regression for summarizer v2.2.0 on the prompt set we gate on. Holding the release until we decide: https://internal/evals/summary/218005

lisa-qa: saw that. ROUGE-L down ~3.8% on the targeted prompt slice (tables & long lists). I can dump failing prompts in the thread.

chris-eng: ack. Suggest two immediate options: (A) pin prod to last-good v2.1.9 and continue triage, or (B) rollback canary and stop rollout. My preference is pin traffic for minimal user impact.

deploybot: Deploybot: Promotion paused by eval gate (rule: prompt-suite-regression). To pin run: `deploybot pin model summarizer:v2.1.9 --route prod`
Override requires 2 approvers: `deploybot override --reason "evarg-check-failure" --approvals 2`

alex-sre: note change window: production pushes are limited until 22:00 PT. Pin is considered a config routing change (allowed) but major rollbacks need SRE signoff. If we pin, I can monitor latency/infra impact.

anna-product: we should update the release notes to call out a blocked regression and planned revert/pin. Want to avoid users assuming new behavior. Also flag to CS to hold any enterprise announcements.

mike-release: proposal: apply pin to v2.1.9 for prod now, open a triage ticket for v2.2.0, run bisect on the model packaging changes. @lisa-qa @chris-eng please +1 for pin so we can execute.

lisa-qa: +1 :thumbsup: I'll attach the failing prompt list and a short eval runbook in the ticket.

chris-eng: +1. I'll start a bisect with reduced prompt-suite and prepare a hotfix branch if we find a packaging/regression commit. Runbook snippet I will follow: ```steps:
1) pin prod to summarizer:v2.1.9 (deploybot)
2) run bisect on v2.2.0 commits with focused prompts
3) if commit identified -> branch + hotfix build -> canary test
4) promote hotfix after QA signoff or keep pin until resolved```

deploybot: Deploybot: Pin executed: summarizer route=prod -> v2.1.9 (rolled to 100%). Action by chris-eng at 2180057040.

alex-sre: monitoring in place, no infra anomalies seen so far. Will escalate if rolling latency > 10th pct threshold.

mike-release: thanks team. I'll open the triage ticket and add notes to release doc + notify CS. We'll reconvene in 30m if triage yields a fix candidate.

anna-product: noted — holding customer-facing changelog until we confirm fix or permanent revert.
